ClientResponses.Response: Hello, and thank you for your review of the Ironwood 885. Although smoke coming from the hopper may look alarming, it doesn’t necessarily mean that there is a fire inside. Actual hopper fires are very rare and fairly obvious due to the blackened pellets at the bottom. Typically, backburn is more just pellets becoming ignited at the opposite end of the auger tube even though the visible smoke is coming from the hopper, which usually occurs if the grill does not go through a complete shutdown. While cleaning the ash out of the firepot can also help prevent airflow issues that could cause backburn, there are other possible causes as well, such as an issue with the fan (or a fan that was removed and reinstalled upside-down) and even if the grill is not on a level surface. What may be worth doing next time is calling Customer Service before the grill is turned on. This way the agent can thoroughly look over everything through the camera on your phone and make any corrections that are needed. Afterward, a test run might even be done to see how the grill performs. Regardless of what the reason is for the backburn, there is a solution, and Traeger Support is available to help you find it.

ClientResponses.Response: Hi, and thanks for your review of the Ironwood 885. Unless there is severe damage, the typical Traeger should last for many years. And even though a fire can potentially render the grill unusable, they can almost always be easily avoided. While the majority of fires are due to excessive grease buildup inside the grill, having one caused by an auger jam is much less common. Auger jams are the result of some type of obstruction inside the auger, which can include wood dust or pellets that have absorbed too much moisture, even from humidity over a long enough time, then dried into a solid clump. To keep this from happening, it is always a good idea to remove the pellets and clear the auger prior to long term storage, as well as occasionally check the bottom of the hopper for wood dust. You can also limit the amount of dust that gets into the hopper in the first place by scooping/sifting the pellets out of the bag instead of pouring them in directly. To get more information on these topics, just search “Cleaning Your Traeger Pellet Grill”, and “How to Remove & Replace Pellets” on the Traeger website, then click on the SUPPORT link above the results.
ClientResponses.Name: Traeger Grills

Results.ReviewText:
My wife bought this grill for me 3 years ago for Father’s Day. I was very excited because I’d heard all the wonderful things about it. It was also a rather extravagant gift at nearly $1800 all in (prices have come down a bit).  First the good:  It is a superior product over most other grills.  It cooks evenly and the e wood pellets make anything you cook taste SO good!  The supersmole feature is an excellent touch as well but only if it’s a small project like a small ham or pork shoulder (for larger items such as Goose, Turkey, etc) I would still recommend a standalone smoker.  It’s Reasonably easy to operate and the app (when it works; more on that later) He is really terrific and helpful.

Now the bad news:  The app loses connection regularly And restoring it can often take quite a bit of time, which is pretty inconvenient when you’re trying to get something cooked. But that’s the least of the issues. The auger got jammed (Without us, realizing it, and without any alert on the app) Which backed up all of the pellets into the hopper box, which started a fire. We did not panic; we simply removed all the pellets shut down the grill And waited for everything to burn off which it did pretty quickly. We contacted customer service and we had to replace the control board and sensor which we did (about $500) and we took the motor off and cleared the auger manually as instructed. Ever since that time, the grill simply does not work. It takes forever to get started, and the auger still does not work properly. We reached out to support who suggested a few different companies in the area that could come out and service the grill. We chose one of those. ($100) After two weeks when they came out, they basically told us the grill was shot. They said, even if they could repair it, the cost would be more than that of a new Traeger. But, they wouldn’t repair it, because they couldn’t ensure that it would be safe after the fire.

So now, we have a (With all associated costs) a $2,000 platter box. We made one final call to customer service who said that there was really nothing they could do about it and that these things happen. And, I get it. Nothing lasts forever. As I said at the beginning, it’s a next level Product to begin with and when it works, it’s fantastic. But, it appears as though the shelflife of this is 3.5 years.  So, depending on your perspective and bank account, you lease the grill in effect, for $571 a year and then apparently throw it out?

Overall, we’re disappointed because we don’t have that kind of money. And, the amount of time we had to spend on this thing not to mention the money, which ultimately did not even yield into a useable Product was pretty frustrating. Customer service was very polite and kind, but, it’s clear that these things have a life expectancy. So, despite the fact, I do not prefer propane cooked grilled food, That’s what I’m back to.

This isn’t a post to tell you not to buy this unit, just to be aware of what you’re getting yourself into.
Results.Title: Beware. Not a long term product. Not worth the $

To be a certified specialist for repairing Traegers, a local dealer will need to have an employee go through a comprehensive training course before they are authorized to work on service eligible grills. Although part replacement itself usually isn’t difficult, diagnosing an issue can require more in-depth knowledge of how the grills operate. In some situations, regardless of if it is for identifying a problem, or replacing a part, it is not always feasible for a dealer to have a technician available to work on all of the different products that they sell based on staffing and other legitimate factors, especially one that can make house calls. In the case of Traegers, there is often an alternative, with at-store repair still being an option as long as the grill can be brought into the closest authorized location. But since this may not be possible, the warranty is considered self-service coverage, even if it isn’t always the case. However, when it is, you’ll at least have Traeger Customer Service to help with the diagnosis, 365 days a year up until 10:00 PM MT. And while parts replacement is designed to be very easy, you can even call us when it’s time to put the new component in, should you want someone on the line when you do it. With the likely ease of the replacement, and the step-by-step assistance available from Traeger Customer Service, please consider letting us work with you to get your grill running properly. ClientResponses.Response: Hi, and thanks for reviewing the Ironwood 885. If you are able to connect your Traeger to WiFi at all, then there should only be a few things that can be causing it to drop. As long as your home network frequency is 2.4 GHz, and nothing has changed on the router or phone, the most likely culprit is going to be the signal strength to the grill. You can actually see the current strength on your Ironwood’s controller by pressing the Menu button, then going to WiFi Information. For a reliable connection, the signal should be between -30 and –70, though it can fluctuate based on other external factors. If it is outside of this range, or appears to fluctuate substantially, you can either try moving the grill closer to the router, or the router (or an extender) closer to the grill for improving the connection. There are a few other things that can be tried as well, but you don’t have to do any of them on your own. Traeger Customer Service is available every day of the year up until 10:00 PM MT to help you with your grill’s connection. Our agents also have access to a tool that will check your network for potential problems and suggest some ways to resolve any that are found. Even if your Ironwood is no longer under warranty, you’ll always have access to our support line at 1-800-TRAEGER for as long as you own your grill.

ClientResponses.Response: Hello, and thank you for your feedback on the Ironwood 885. Although cleaning out the hopper is a good idea every so often as part of your regular maintenance schedule, it certainly should not be needed after every cook. If this is turning out to be the case, there is a good chance that the issue is related to sawdust accumulating at the bottom of the hopper. To limit this, try to avoid pouring entire bags directly in, since this has the potential to also include a lot of dust. While pellets will leave the mill clean, some dust can develop during transportation and handling. For an alternative to pouring out the bag, consider using a slotted spoon or colander to scoop the pellets into the hopper, which will greatly reduce what gets into the grill in the first place. As for the network frequency, even though 5 GHz is faster, the grill uses 2.4 GHz due to its longer range, which is often more important for outdoor WiFi connections than transferring a lot of data quickly. Because of this, most ISPs still provide both, but sometimes they have to be separated if the router keeps switching to the faster frequency. This should be pretty easy to do with the assistance of your provider, but we will be happy to help in any way we can.
ClientResponses.Name: Traeger Grills

Results.ReviewText: I bought the 885 about a month ago at Costco and have never regretted buying it.  You can't even compare it to a propane BBQ, The Traeger is so superior. The quality of the Traeger is amazing and what gets cooked on it is unbelievable.  I cook chicken wings, chicken thighs and tri tip and they are cooked to perfection. Then I put the zucchini, yellow squash, summer squash and broccoli and have never tasted vegetable that good. In other words, you can't go wrong buying and using a Traeger.
Results.Title: You can't beat a Traeger!

Results.ReviewText: Love how fast it heats up and that it can hold lower temps for hours. I live in Arizona and previous grills would hold onto the outside temperature, making it hard to do longer cooks during summer months. I will never stray from Traeger again!
Results.Title: Never leaving again

Results.ReviewText: Have had my Ironwood 650 for about a year. Have had no problems with it. Works great and food comes out good every time. Love the super smoke feature. This is my second Traeger. Upgraded from a smaller one and plan to be in the Traeger family for a long time. My Traeger rep is great! We love it!
Results.Title: Great all around grill and smoker!

Results.ReviewText: I upgraded from the Pro 34 to the IW 885 due to the fact my 34 would not reach temps of 400. My 885 has no problems reaching higher temps. I Love Everything about the 885 except 1 thing. The grates. The 34 were split grates and So easy to clean. The 885 is 1 big grate. Other than that, I am Very happy with it and would recommend to everyone.
Results.Title: Excellent Grill

Results.ReviewText: This smoker is outstanding best outdoor BBQ investment.  Ease of control with WIFIRE set it and forget it!
Results.Title: Best Pellet Grill Ever

Results.ReviewText:
I am an experienced smoker. Everyone loves this product the first season they own it. I always give any product over $1,000 a year to see how it stands up. I would never purchase another smoker from Traeger. 
Moderate use and the outer coating is dissipating. The machine does a terrible job maintaining a constant temp. For example, week 1 a 7lb Boston Butt will be completely cooked ( nearly over done ) in 7-8 hours, the next week a 7lb Boston Butt will need an extra 2 hours. We put several industrial thermometers and found huge swings in the temps by up to 20(f) on either side of the unit. In another word, our smoker said the temp was 252(f). In reality, the smoker was closer to 215(f). The next week we again saw temps around 250 stated and the temps was actually rising above 300. Another problem is the the on/off switch is temperamental.  Sometimes it will not power the unit, at other times we have just seen the machine turn off. The machine frequently has a hard time igniting, this even times directly following a thorough cleaning.
Results.Title: Ironwood Series 885 doesn't stand the test of time

Results.ReviewText:
I purchased a BBQ075 more than 13 years ago and every time I have a problem Traeger stands behind it. My control unit broke a month ago and Treager sent me a control unit that is compatible for the 075, but the opening on the 075 is just a little too small to receive the new unit. Traeger is sending me a new hopper that will be able to mount the new controller, free of charge. They always go above and beyond.
Adrian Huff
Results.Title: Service is above and beyond!!

Results.ReviewText: I just bought the Redwood 650 at Costco today, essentially an Ironwood 650. Followed the instructions, seasoned per the manual. As I was dissembling to clean out, I saw that the paint on the drip trough was burnt off. Are you kidding me? For a $1000 grill, this should not happen. I'm returning this to Costco and won't be buying a Traeger product again.
Results.Title: Returned

Results.ReviewText: I bought this a few months ago and the back of it has already started to rust. We reached out to customer support and they said because it is not impeding cooking where it is rusting they won’t cover it. Absolutely crazy. DO NOT BUY ANY OF THESE.
Results.Title: They don’t stand behind their products

Results.ReviewText: Thought i was buying the “new” Ironwood verses a version 1 unit that has been out for 2 years.   UGH.  I do still like it but felt a little mislead by the marketing.
Results.Title: Not the new version that was recently announced.

Results.ReviewText: Upgraded from a Pro 22 and couldn't be happier. Set up was easy and the grill performs perfectly.
Results.Title: Great grill!

Results.ReviewText: If you are on the fence about getting a Traeger, just do it.  You wont regret it!  This grill is super easy to use and the results are delicious!
Results.Title: Finally!

Results.ReviewText: I’ve had my 650 for 3 years no rust no problems I have replaced the probes only it still works great!! Well worth the money and more than enough room for a lot of meat. Even the cover is still going strong faded a bit but still solid 👍🏼
Results.Title: Excellent buy I’m a fan for life!!!

Results.ReviewText: What a great machine! Well built, easy to put together, rock solid performance and ease of use. I have recommended Traeger so many people in the short time since starting my journey with my Ironwood. I only wish I had bought the larger model as I'm so anxious to expand the volume I am doing. I've never wanted to smoke due to the monitoring of the process..... Traeger takes the need to babysit your cook away. The phone app is exceptional!
Results.Title: Get a Traeger!!

Results.ReviewText: The smoker grill I bought was easy to put together and everything works great
Results.Title: Ironwood 885

Results.ReviewText: Absolutely love our smoker best thing we ever bought! So easy to use and the WiFi is the best part.
Results.Title: Better then better

Results.ReviewText: 100% satisfied with my purchase so far. Was always skeptical about pellet smokers, but the convenience is awesome
Results.Title: Love this smoker!

Results.ReviewText:
Two years from purchase.  I would not purchase again.
Cons-horrible way to remove pellets from bin that requires scooping or else pellets fall everywhere; back exterior rack holder is fine, but cover snags on it when donning/doffing; moving grill even a few feet can cause grease bucket to fall off; add-on front table not deep enough; cover way too tight; electric plug is hard to plug into unit-underneath and requires direct visualization 
Pro-cooks fine
Results.Title: Needs improvement

Results.ReviewText: I bought the 885 Ironwood mainly because of WiFire. I come to find out that the Traeger App is not compatible with my Samsung Galaxy phone. Now I need a new $700 phone to add to the $1700.00 that the grill cost! Too bad there wasn't a note somewhere that listed what it takes in your phone to use the App!
Results.Title: WiFire

Results.ReviewText: Brand New Grill close to 2000 invested at this point between Grill, accessories, pellets etc.  Attempted to cook on grill 5 times it has only worked twice.  Spent over 3 hours on the phone with tech support on 3 different occasions.  Getting same message each time and Tier 0 wants to step me through the same steps over and over.  Read the notes from the last hour long call.  Luckily i have a good grill not a Traeger that works when turned on so i was able to salvage a couple of expensive pieces of meat.  Traeger finally after having issue escalated is sending me a part to install.  Wasted pellets, meat that should have been smoked, and hours of my time i will never get back.  Traeger offers I'm sorry.  I wish i had the recording ill bet they said "I'm sorry" 50 times. Poor customer experience to put it in terms that is appropriate for children.  Had i purchased this locally it would already be returned.  Serves me right buying at a show and Traeger shipping it to me.
Results.Title: Grill is junk customer experience is lacking

Results.ReviewText: Just what they said it was!  Great smoker and this is my 2nd Treager.
Results.Title: If you like it buy it again

Results.ReviewText: I bought my first ironwood from Home Depot got it home and it had all kinds of damage. Then Traeger sends me another one today.  I put it together and I realized that It was damaged as well. Now I’m suppose to replace the damage part and send it back. $1600 in and I still can’t cook on this grill. 2 grills later and hoper replacement. I’ve spent more time putting grills together and replacing parts than cooking on it. For my trouble they are sending me a chicken rub….. smh.
Results.Title: Chicken rub for your troubles

Results.ReviewText:
Alright, listen up all you backyard BBQ enthusiasts. If you're still grilling on some wimpy little charcoal grill, it's time to upgrade to the Traeger Ironwood 885.  This thing is a beast. It's like having your own personal pit master right in your backyard.👏

I have wanted a Traeger for a long time, and this beauty is what dreams are made of! It's packed with all sorts of fancy tech features, like Wi-Fi connectivity and easy pellet hopper cleanout. But the best part? The food. Oh my god, the food. 🤤 You know those mouthwatering smoked briskets you see on TV and wish you could make? Well, I've made them on this Ironwood 885! It was like a flavor bomb went off in my mouth, it's so good, and ever since I've gotten this grill, I've contemplated becoming a full-time pit master, just have to figure out how to convince my wife. 😂

Anyway...let's talk about convenience. You can control the temperature and monitor your food from your phone, so you can sit back and relax while the Ironwood 885 does all the work. It's like having a personal assistant, but way cooler. 😎

Now, I know what you're thinking. "But Tom, isn't it expensive?" Yeah, it is. But you know what else is expensive? Eating out at a fancy BBQ joint every weekend. With my Ironwood 885, I can save my money and impress my friends and family with my newfound grilling skills.

If you've been waiting to pull the trigger, go get yourself a Traeger Ironwood 885 and start grilling like a boss. Your taste buds will thank you. And who knows, maybe we can even start a BBQ empire together, if you live in the Nashville area? 🔥
Results.Title: Alright, listen up all you backyard BBQ enthusiast

Results.ReviewText: I cooked on my grill for the 3rd time yesterday, put chicken on as I left for church, followed the instructions for chicken quarters, used app on my phone to increase heat 1 hour after I left. It was done when we returned!!  I will probably do this every Sunday!  So happy with it.  It was a big investment but worth it.
Results.Title: Ironwood 885

Results.ReviewText: Like the upgrades...improved liner, new fan is much quieter, pellet sensor is a plus, already used it to avoid an early shutdown on a brisket.  Already purchased and added a front folding shelf, and cover.  Love it!
Results.Title: My newest smoker

Results.ReviewText: I was very pleased with how well the instructions were written and how clear the images were for assembling the grill. I have used it twice so far. I think  it will be fun trying out new recipes on various cuts of meat .
Results.Title: Trading in my gas grill for a Traeger Grill

Results.ReviewText: 3 cooks in and very easy to use. Will be recommending to others. Great product

Results.ReviewText: We've been considering the Traeger Ironwood 885 for 2 years! We finally made the purchase and we are super excited! I've already smoked cherries and water for the smoked ice cubes plus made 4 meals just in the past 5 days. Creating the special add-ins for drinks and making meals that have the hardwood smoke infused into them are what dreams are made of! So grateful to have this in our line-up of hunting, cooking and get-togethers!
Results.Title: Smoked Ice! Drinks are even better!

Results.ReviewText: Great product.  I love being able to monitor the cooking/smoking on my cell phone.
Results.Title: Great

Results.ReviewText: Amazing smoker!  Built like a tank!  2nd Treager I’ve purchased both are amazing

Results.ReviewText: More expensive than the competition but worth it. The quality and ease of use is worth the extra money.
Results.Title: Worth the extra price!

Results.ReviewText: Hard to clean. Temperature swings immediately and continually. Only been  a month of ownership. Traeger doesn’t care.
Results.Title: Stay away

Results.ReviewText: It is still in the box. It is winter here in Indiana.
Results.Title: Waiting for summer

Results.ReviewText: Shipped with a non-working fan when the fan arrived the screws that mounted it to the frame were so tight it was impossible to get them off drill them out
Results.Title: Good customer service just a poor quality control

Results.ReviewText: Awesome smoker/ grill.  Perfect packaging and easy to set up right out of the box.
Results.Title: Perfect and easy to set up and use!

Results.ReviewText: 1st grill delivered was damaged. Customer service was great and had a replacement grill delivered in 3 days. The pickup crew for the 1st grill was a fiasco and took nearly 2 weeks to finally remove. Inconvenient have 2 large grills on a small patio, but not the end of the world.  Been using grill almost nightly and its the best grill/smoker I've ever owned!  The Traeger app is very buggy, has to be closed and reopened to get accurate temp read backs. Also, the temp spin dial setting is off center by 5 degrees.  Still, overall, best I've ever owned!!
Results.Title: 1st grill damaged, 2nd grill GREAT!

Results.ReviewText:
I love this smoker. I have been wanting a Traeger for such a long time, but haven't been able to get one as I was in a condo for five years. This was the first thing that I ordered once I moved into my house. Dove right in and cooked a pork shoulder for my first meal and was extremely happy with the results and the way the grill performed.

The only reason this is getting four stars was because the grill arrived, it was damaged from shipping and had some popped welds in the grease trough that I couldn't confirm were because of the shipping or because the metal wasn't properly heat relieved post welding. I got on the phone to put in a warranty claim and was taken care of right away, the rep Karen was fantastic and helped every step of the way. Received the replacement in 3 days and was in perfect condition. The smoker has been five stars since!
Results.Title: Amazing product but was damaged

Results.ReviewText: I purchased one a couple weeks ago and we have been trying all types of cuts of meats. Beef, chicken (many times), pork, veggies, bread. Following recipes by traeger as well as others. But so far everything has been sub par. The food comes out pale like we have boiled it. We were promised that it would be the best meat ever, chicken would be crispy and delicious and the skin will not cook or crisp no matter how long or high temperature we used. I reached out to customer service and basically was told to watch you tube for recipes. Even though most of the recipes we used are traeger's recipe and quality cuts of meat, it has not been good.
Results.Title: Bad experience

Results.ReviewText: I have to admit I absolutely regret getting this grill.  I was so excited to get it but have been disappointed again and again.  The level of Smokey flavor is low.  Worse is the traeger recipes (off their site) are not accurate at all.  The grill temperature is way off resulting is cool times that are way off.  I’ve tried multiple recipes and none have been close.  A 3-hour cook takes 5-6 hours to complete and only has a slight Smokeyness. The even increasing the temp by 15-20 degrees it still takes much longer than the recipe.  100% regret buying.
Results.Title: Absolute disappointment

Results.ReviewText: Love the connection to my phone. Makes smoking easy and everything tastes great!
Results.Title: Awesome smoker!

Results.ReviewText: I, like many others, got suckered into the whole Traeger family and community thing thinking they would stand by their product and with their family members. Before you purchase a Traeger, be sure you search "Traeger Paint Bubbling" and then make your decision. I wish I would have known this before spending over $1K on a product that is starting to look like garbage after barely two years of fairly light use. See my attached picture. I just got off with Traeger support and, like so many others, they dismiss any responsibility for faulty paint, coating, or manufacturing process. The paint literally looks like it's being boiled off of the grill and it is spreading.
Results.Title: Beware: Outer coating bubbles off.

Results.ReviewText: Love using this smoker.  Very easy!  The Traeger app is very useful - has good instructions and recipes to help you get started.  Also love the variety of pellets to choose from.
Results.Title: Super easy to use!

Results.ReviewText: This is an absolutely amazing smoker! I have owned a zgrill which was horrible!!!! This smoker is amazing I love all the features! Well thought out!!
Results.Title: Best purchase

Results.ReviewText:
But an Ironwood 650 grill. Follow all information on App or on the smoker display. 
That is it! You will now be a BBQ genius. 
This smoker is great, easy to use. Everything I have cook so far has come out perfect. Definitely you should get this one.
Results.Title: How to become a BBQ genius!

Results.ReviewText: This Traeger is amazing.  best grill  I’ve ever owned I’ve cooked with it every day since I got it. The Wi-Fi control is very useful when I’m trying to take care of kids and smoke a delicious piece of meat.
Results.Title: The Perfect Grill

Results.ReviewText: How did I live without this grill?  It was easy to put together and easy to use and we made the best brisket we have ever made!  The WiFire technology is absolutely easy and wonderful.
Results.Title: LOVE IT!

Results.ReviewText: Very pleased with my purchase. This is quite the upgrade from my old Traeger. Much larger, many more features, and the WiFire option is very nice. Just wish I could start the grill from the app. Tray liner is a nice addition to keep it clean.
Results.Title: Very Pleased

Results.ReviewText: Loving my new smoker, Works like a charm. So easy to learn on
Results.Title: Love the Ironwood

Results.OriginalProductName: Traeger Ironwood Series 650 Pellet Grill + Sensor
Results.ReviewText: Traeger came dented and was replaced with no questions asked! Excellent customer service
Results.Title: CUSTOMER SERVICE

Results.ReviewText: I’ve had a Traeger Junior for about 13 years and finally upgraded. Holy moly! There’s so much room for activities! I had friends over and easily fit 6 racks of ribs and was repeatedly told they were the best they’ve ever had. All I did was put some dry rub on them and let the Traeger do its work. It maintained temp throughout and the super smoke feature took it to the next level. Not much more you could ask for. It’s almost fool proof.
Results.Title: Simply the best

We have made pulled pork and all sorts of other smoked ribs or grilled burger’s and chops

Results.Title: Gift

Results.ReviewText: I give the Traeger 4 stars only because I have only used it 2 times on higher temps and once on 220 degrees to smoke some salmon.   The smoke flavor was a bit weak but I didn’t use the super smoke feature.  We are still learning how to use the grill but so far we are satisfied.   The grill took less than hour to set up, connected right away to our WiFi and the temps have been with 5-10 degrees of where the temp was set.   The 3 times we used the grill the food cooked was moist and flavorful.
